core_reducers.name: Lean tool output
core_reducers.technique: Run scripts with their --lean/quiet flags; never paste raw JSON or full file dumps into context.

core_reducers.name: Read only what's needed
core_reducers.technique: Read specific line ranges, not whole files; don't re-read a file already in context.

core_reducers.name: Compact often
core_reducers.technique: Summarize and drop stale context (/compact-style) before it bloats; keep only the working set.

core_reducers.name: Batch independent work
core_reducers.technique: Do independent reads/edits in one pass; avoid back-and-forth round-trips.

core_reducers.name: Prefer mechanical over Claude
core_reducers.technique: Use the free Python protocols + free engine pool for anything that doesn't need Claude; reserve Claude for judgement.

core_reducers.name: Terse writing
core_reducers.technique: No restated headings, no filler, no marketing words; every sentence earns its place.

core_reducers.name: Cache & reuse
core_reducers.technique: Reuse prior results and the hub data instead of re-deriving; don't recompute what's stored.

core_reducers.name: Delegate huge context
core_reducers.technique: For large-context jobs, dispatch a focused sub-agent with only the slice it needs, not the whole history.
